final_report: The patient demonstrates severe cumulative bone marrow suppression with recurrent Grade 4 neutropenia, Grade 3 thrombocytopenia, and anemia, leading to high infection and bleeding risks. Prolonged dehydration and bronchitis indicate impaired immune function and poor physiologic reserve. ECOG 2 and smoking history further elevate mortality risk due to reduced treatment tolerance and increased vulnerability to multi-organ failure.
